title: TEI-XML encoded transcriptions of 318 early modern play editions (Craig–Egan dataset)
notes:
ZIP of TEI-XML transcriptions of 318 editions of 288 early modern plays by 77 authors (keyed/corrected transcriptions of early printed editions, related to EEBO-TCP texts, with corrections by Gabriel Egan in derivative subsets). The count of 318 editions is stated on the Zenodo record; word count not stated.

Justification: Freely downloadable, project-released TEI-XML full-text dataset of early modern English drama within 1450–1700, distinct from the catalogued EEBO-TCP and DraCor records; found via a Zenodo search for early modern TEI play transcriptions.
Found at: https://zenodo.org/records/14289452
